llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam traits: mixing religious content with gambling/slot promo; offering unusually large bonuses and discounts; handling an excessive range of products atypical of legitimate e-commerce; linking main actions to suspicious, unbranded third-party addresses; and registering very recently with no evidence of a real company or legitimate/updated business info. These characteristics closely match the profile of a Fake Online Shopping scam.
